question_en: Does the physical action acquire material that is analysed ex vivo, and is acquisition or adequacy part of the evaluated loop?
question_cn: 物理动作是否取得将被离体分析的材料，且取材或充分性属于被评价的闭环？

question_en: Does the system deliberately perturb tissue or physiology and use the elicited response as diagnostic evidence?
question_cn: 系统是否有意扰动组织或生理状态，并把诱发响应作为诊断证据？

question_en: Does feedback change sensor pose, viewpoint, contact, coverage, trajectory or acquisition settings to obtain a new in-vivo observation?
question_cn: 反馈是否改变传感器姿态、视点、接触、覆盖、轨迹或采集参数，以获得新的在体观察？
no_action_en: Exclude from the complete embodied diagnostic system set, or retain as a supporting technology
no_action_cn: 从完整具身诊断系统集合中排除，或仅作为支撑技术保留

question_en: Does one paper evaluate more than one distinct evidence-acquisition episode?
question_cn: 一篇论文是否评价了多个不同的证据获取阶段？
yes_assignment: Create one task-level row per evaluated episode; retain paper-level linkage
no_action_en: Do not force the whole platform into one class
no_action_cn: 不要强行把整个平台归入单一类别
